title: Textbook formulas
description: A baseline: the answers a person gives from the classic formulas without simulating. Bow shock: Billig's correlations for spheres (Billig, J. Spacecraft Rockets 4, 1967, 822) for the standoff and the shock shape. Orbits: each planet on its own Kepler ellipse about the Sun, from the given state, with no other body. Cylinder shedding: the textbook value St = 0.2 at every Reynolds number.
